b: I really fancied a minced pie today when shopping. I got pack of 6 as tgey were only sold as that and some brandy cream. When I got home from shopping I had 2 mince pies and a slash of brandy cream., it was yummy and tasted like Christmas in a bowl. I have then decided to scan it with my fitnesspall 1000, as in one fucking thousand calories! And I have 2 more portions left another 2000 kcal.

I can't justify 1000 kcal snack in the evening that is 2 hours of running. I also know that if it's still here tomorrow I will eat it on Saturday and then again on Sunday. I hate throwing food away but food eaten that isn't good for me is still food wasted. I enjoyed my mince pie but the rest of them aren't working towards my goals so off in the bin they go. I don't feel bad for doing it, I'm taking care of myself and I'm surprised I managed to have enough sense to do so. 3 years ago I would eat all 6 pies and whole cream in one sitting
